p2bWeakness.F1: the cold-recovery gate handed Process A's sourceBasis to Process B, so verification proved value matching, not independent recovery
p2bWeakness.F2: computeTrustedSourceBasis hashes executable PATH strings, not contents or a signed manifest
p2bWeakness.F3: the qualifier never consulted sourceKind, so a CONTROLLED_STUB record with a matching basis qualified

correctedModel.trustedRegistry: makeTrustedSourceRegistry({epochs, supportedProducerKinds}) — built by the DEPLOYMENT composition from its own configuration
correctedModel.epochs: a LIST, so a legitimate upgrade ADDS an epoch rather than invalidating every historical association
enforcement: a record must match a trusted epoch's basis
the record's sourceKind must be a supported producer kind (FIRST_PARTY_DSH_HOST)
the record's sourceKind must AGREE with the matching epoch's kind
correctedModel.verifierAuthority: the registry is constructed at the composition boundary (src/composition/execution_association.ts) from the deployment's own executable facts; it is never read from a record or a handoff file

contentVsPathDistinction.hashed: executable PATH strings (worker bin + node executable), plus the worker bin basename and the port adapter id
contentVsPathDistinction.notHashed: executable CONTENTS, a build manifest, or a signed bundle identity
contentVsPathDistinction.honestLimitation: this is a defensible LOCAL trusted-composition boundary: it establishes that the deployment was CONFIGURED with this executable, not that the bytes on disk were the expected ones. It is not remote attestation and not hardware identity.
contentVsPathDistinction.whyAcceptable: the ruling forbids cryptographic attestation theater and explicitly permits a defensible local provenance chain; the limitation is stated on every qualified result (sourceLimit)

historicalCompatibility.behavior: a second trusted epoch admits a historical record without invalidating it
historicalCompatibility.test: test/trajectory_p2c_admission_integrity.test.ts 'a second epoch admits a historical record without invalidating it'
